name: noctcore
headline: Autonomy, governed.
subline: Agents write the code. Every change still passes a gate.
alt: noctcore. Autonomy, governed. Agents write the code. Every change still passes a gate.
description: An agent's diff travels toward your branch through lint rules, repo checks and a verification gauntlet. Shell injection stops at the lint rules, a CI job that installs packages while it holds a secret stops at the repo checks, and a skipped test stops at the gauntlet.
